subject: 😸 Steal a film’s color
body:
Drop in a frame you love, CinemaLut measures the grade and

builds you a LUT for your own footage.



Product Hunt 

( https://www.producthunt.com/?utm_campaign=56860_2026-10-15&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_source=Daily+Digest )





The Leaderboard



Thursday, Oct 15



by Product Hunt



Old songs, film stills, hotkeys



gm legends



Today: an app that plays back the year a song belonged to, a way

to lift the color off a film still and put it on your own

footage, and a Mac that does the thing when you hold a key and

ask.



Hot on the leaderboard right now  —

Play a song, see where you were



•



Nostaliga ↗ 

( https://www.producthunt.com/posts/nostaliga?utm_campaign=56860_2026-10-15&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_source=Daily+Digest&utm_term=editorial )



—  Rediscover the days behind your favorite

songs



Nostaliga plays a song and shows you the life you

were living the last time you had it on repeat. It reads your

listening history and brings back the photos, the places and the

rides from those weeks, pulling from Apple Music, Last.fm,

Photos, Health, Strava and Calendar. Dinakar says every time he

hears 1-800-273-8255 he is back in 2017, his first year of

cycling, doing long rides with it on. That song is named after

the old US suicide prevention number, and researchers counted

almost 10,000 extra calls to the line 

( https://www.cbsnews.com/news/logic-1-800-273-8255-song-suicide-prevention/ )

 across the 34 days it was most talked about.



•



CinemaLut ↗ 

( https://www.producthunt.com/posts/cinemalut?utm_campaign=56860_2026-10-15&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_source=Daily+Digest&utm_term=editorial )



—  Any frame's color, as a LUT for yours.



CinemaLut takes the color out of a film still and

puts it on your footage. Drop in the frame you like, a movie

screenshot or a photo, and it measures what is actually going on

in the grade: the tone curve, the tints sitting in the shadows,

the midtones and the highlights, how saturated each band is. Then

you drop in your own shot, log or Rec.709 from any camera, and it

builds the LUT from that measurement. It runs in the browser, and

there are 60 looks in there already as .cube files for Resolve,

Premiere, Final Cut and CapCut. Dil got tired of the gap between

seeing a grade he loved and getting anywhere near it himself.



•



Atticus ↗ 

( https://www.producthunt.com/posts/atticus?utm_campaign=56860_2026-10-15&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_source=Daily+Digest&utm_term=editorial )



—  Hold a key, talk, and your Mac does what you

asked



Atticus is a Mac assistant you hold a key to talk

to. Control-Option-Space, say open Spotify and play lo-fi, or

find me a desk lamp on Amazon and put it in the cart, then let

go. It reads what is on your screen, so it will also answer a

question about the PDF you have open or draft a reply to the

email. Opening an app never goes near a model and lands in under

a tenth of a second, and anything that does runs on the Claude

plan you already pay for. Ask for the same thing twice and it

saves a shortcut, which roughly halves the time. It asks before

it buys, sends or deletes anything, and it is free and open

source.
